title: Human Nature Odyssey, Episode 27. Cycle of Memory and Societal Alzheimer’s
content:
Can societies get Alzheimer's?

From the pyramids of Ancient Egypt to cloud storage, humanity has gone to extraordinary lengths to preserve its memories. But what happens when memories fade, photographs disappear, and the stories of our ancestors are lost?
